modeBoundaryReview.conclusion: The entire 98-byte module imports app-initial.akn as e and okn as t, invokes t, and re-exports e as fetchChatGptProject. There is no local request implementation or product-mode guard. The re-exported implementation must be classified using existing upstream contracts/callers.

The exported Pt component binds project save to app-initial.iOn, source upload hook to oOn, deletion hook to sOn, local-folder eligibility to fkn and edit capability to gkn. The same dialog conditionally renders local-folders-section.t under s && L && je(i). Its direct safeGet requests for gizmo details and connector scopes are separate from those imported mutation implementations. A module-name based removal would discard the explicit local-folder branch; upstream local/remote mutation contracts and caller guards are required.

Pt binds t to app-shared.$wt and issues safeGet for /gizmos/{gizmo_id_or_short_url} and /projects/{project_id}/connector_scopes. The details query is enabled only on advanced view when instructions or memory_scope is missing. Connector loading is enabled by Lt(project), whose complete function tests gizmo_snorlax_type == null. These predicates are data/view conditions, not independently proven Work/ChatGPT product-mode gates. The existing TFt/AW wrapper contract does not directly bind the different imported $wt facade.

The entire module exports a project_save metadata parser (t/o), timestamp normalizer (n/s), initializer (r/f) and source-type message descriptor table (i/d). It contains no direct network/IPC/project mutation. The settings module imports all four exports for its source rows. Project-save field names and message labels do not establish whether local project support may be removed.

In contrast, dedicated sFs project-route finally uses oZ without allowWork, hence the documented default false guard. Its earlier mapping redirects can pass chatGptProjectId through state. That route cannot be treated as the exclusive caller or exclusion boundary for shared project settings/local task handling.
